profile.name: Abhigya Kanungo
profile.tagline: Curious about how things work. Passionate about building how they should.
profile.heroIntro: Hey, I'm Abhigya. I bridge product requirements, frontend code, modern AI tools, and brand storytelling. If a problem is messy or unstructured, I stay calm, break down the fundamentals, and build a clean, practical solution.
profile.superpowerQuote: My superpower is simple: I am a resourceful problem-solver who just gets things done. If I don't know how to do something, I will spend the time troubleshooting, experimenting and figuring it out. I thrive in fast-moving environments, staying calm and finding a way to move projects forward, no matter how messy things look at first. I genuinely enjoy working right at the intersection of business, operations, and technology, with a strong belief that the best products today are built by combining Human Intelligence with AI Execution.

curiosity.title: First-Principles Curiosity
curiosity.quote: I love breaking down complex systems—whether it's a payment reconciliation engine, a GenAI bidding workflow, or a frontend component tree—to understand how every piece fits together under the hood. I learn by building. When new AI tools come out, I don't just read about them; I use them to build working interactive prototypes.

sportsResilience.title: Calm Under Pressure
sportsResilience.quote: As a competitive Table Tennis (TT) Champion, high-stakes matches trained my split-second strategic reflexes, resilience under pressure, and drive to out-prepare the competition. When code breaks or deployment windows tighten, I stay level-headed and execute.

flagship.title: Rapido Bikepool & Highway RideShare
flagship.tagline: Formalizing organic commuter bike-sharing into a zero-detour, peer-to-peer mobility product.
flagship.category: Mobility UX • Product Architecture • Live Telemetry Engine
flagship.linkedinHook: Why are two-wheeler owners secretly using the Rapido Captain app every single morning? They aren't taxi drivers. They are daily commuters sharing their empty pillion seat to split petrol costs. Here is how we formalize organic commuter bike-sharing into a zero-detour product.
flagship.problemBreakdown: Daily commuters spend up to 40% of their daily earnings on cab and auto fares. Concurrently, tens of thousands of two-wheeler riders travel along identical tech corridors with empty pillion seats. Commercial ride-hailing apps classify every rider as a taxi driver, generating steep friction for working professionals.

socialMotivations.title: Peer Cost Recovery
socialMotivations.description: Fair petrol expense sharing (₹35 – ₹52 per city trip) with zero commercial profit-mongering.

socialMotivations.title: Professional Networking
socialMotivations.description: Building spontaneous community among tech professionals commuting along common corridors.

socialMotivations.title: Green Travel & Traffic Relief
socialMotivations.description: Halving single-occupancy vehicles on choked morning corridors, reducing carbon footprints.

coreInnovations.title: 5-Minute Hosting Radar
coreInnovations.bullet1: Host broadcasts availability for exactly 5 minutes along their natural commute corridor (e.g. Mahalaxmi Nagar ➔ Scheme No 54, Indore).
coreInnovations.bullet2: If no co-rider matches within 5 minutes, host rides solo with zero penalty, zero stress, and zero algorithmic punishment.

coreInnovations.title: Pink Pool Community
coreInnovations.bullet1: Verified women-only host and passenger corridor pairing for complete safety and comfort.
coreInnovations.bullet2: Mandatory DigiLocker Government ID safety verification checkpoints integrated natively.

coreInnovations.title: Intercity Highway Engine
coreInnovations.bullet1: Pre-scheduled long-distance rides (e.g., Indore ➔ Bhopal ISBT Terminal, 195km).
coreInnovations.bullet2: Transparent peer cost-split slider (₹360 host seat share vs. ₹2,800 commercial private cab).

zeroDetourMechanism.rule: 100m Walk for Passenger. Zero Detour for Host.
details: Passenger walks 80m – 120m to the nearest main-road bus shelter snapshot point along the host's natural path.
Host maintains forward momentum without entering residential maze alleys.
Strict geolocation corridor SLA limits maximum host route deviation to ≤ 500m.

regulatoryFeasibility.details: Fully aligned with Central Motor Vehicles Guidelines for Non-Commercial Peer Cost Recovery. Since hosts only split actual fuel expenses without commercial profit margins, there is zero commercial yellow-plate permit requirement.

teardowns.title: The Founder Assistant AI Execution Loop
teardowns.hook: Busy founders add 20 to-dos daily to task apps, but passive lists don't execute themselves. Overdue items rot. What if your task list had an active AI execution loop?
teardowns.problemStatement: Existing task management software is entirely passive. It logs tasks but leaves follow-up execution on overwhelmed founders, allowing critical client leads and operational tasks to decay.
solutionArchitecture: Transition from static to-do lists to an active autonomous AI execution loop.
Autonomous LLM engine drafts client follow-up emails, synthesizes meeting actions, and queues API payloads.
Automated voice call escalation protocol for P0 critical tagged tasks overdue by >24 hours.
teardowns.projectedImpact: 70% reduction in overdue operational follow-ups for early-stage founders.

teardowns.title: Curing 'AutoPay Anxiety' — RBI Mandate Control
teardowns.hook: Have you ever felt a spike of anxiety receiving an unexpected subscription debit notification at midnight? Subscription cancellation flows are intentionally fragmented. Here is how we fix AutoPay anxiety.
teardowns.problemStatement: Millions of users experience recurring payment anxiety because pausing or canceling recurring UPI and card mandates requires navigating buried menus across dozens of disparate merchant apps.
solutionArchitecture: Unified RBI Mandate Control Dashboard aggregating all active UPI and card recurring debits in one single view.
Proactive pre-debit push notifications sent 24 hours prior to scheduled billing.
1-Tap 30-Day Freeze Control transmitting instant pause instructions directly to core bank mandate APIs.
teardowns.projectedImpact: Zero unexpected subscription charges; 100% transparent user sovereign control.

teardowns.title: WhatsApp Business Async Scheduling
teardowns.hook: Communicating with international clients late at night creates intrusive friction, but waiting until morning means forgetting the draft. How do we bring native async scheduling to WhatsApp Business?
teardowns.problemStatement: Freelancers and SMB owners work across disparate timezones. Sending late-night messages intrudes on clients' personal downtime, while saving manual drafts leads to forgotten follow-ups.
solutionArchitecture: Native press-and-hold 'Schedule Send' trigger integrated directly into the message action bar.
On-device encrypted queuing storing pending client messages securely until release time.
Time zone smart-suggestions calculating optimal client delivery windows automatically.
teardowns.projectedImpact: Frictionless asynchronous client communication with zero message drop.
